## Libraries
```{r library}
options(java.parameters = "-Xmx30000m")
set.seed(100)
required_Packages_Install <- c("dplyr", "patchwork", "Seurat","ggplot2","DT")
for(Package in required_Packages_Install){
  if(!require(Package,character.only = TRUE)) { 
    install.packages(Package, dependencies=TRUE)
  }
  library(Package,character.only = TRUE)
}
```
## Loading data
I've renamed features.tsv to genes.tsv for Read10X() to work.
```{r data loading}
data_obj <- readRDS("/Users/ladislavbucek/Desktop/UK/Mgr./labgenexp/refractory/STAR/refractory-12-hpaSolo.out/data/processed/data_obj_processed.rds")
data_obj_markers <- readRDS("/Users/ladislavbucek/Desktop/UK/Mgr./labgenexp/refractory/STAR/refractory-12-hpaSolo.out/data/processed/data_obj_markers.rds")
datatable(data_obj_markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 30, wt = avg_log2FC))
```
```{r canonical markers}
features_test <- c("tp63.L","tp63.S",            #basal epidermis
                    "fgfbp2.L","nptx1.L",        #epidermis
                    "epor.L","hba1.S",           #erythrocytes
                    "itln1.L","anxa9.L",         #goblet cells
                    "atp6v0d2.L","foxi1.L",      #ionocytes
                    "iqcd.L","tekt3.L",          #MCCs
                    "sox10.L","slc45a2.L",       #Melanocytes
                    "eno3.L","des.1.L",          #muscle cells
                    "sncb.L","elavl4.L",         #neuronal cells
                    "plod2.L","col9a1-b",        #notochord
                    "fgf10.L","lef1.S",          #ROCs
                    "pax9.L","zic1.L",           #somites and other
                    "foxa1.L","kcna4.S"          #SSCs
                   )
```
```{r dotplot, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width = 16.2}
DotPlot(data_obj, features = features_test) + theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5))
```
# Cluster annotation
Cluster that I was unable to annotate have only goblet cells markers but not higher than most of the other clusters

```{r}

levels(data_obj)
# View the metadata

cluster_labels_m <- levels(data_obj)

# Generate a color palette with the same number of colors as there are clusters
cluster_colors_m <- Polychrome::createPalette(length(cluster_labels_m), c("#ff0000", "#00ff00", "#0000ff"))

# Assign each color to a cluster name
names(cluster_colors_m) <- cluster_labels_m

# Generate the UMAP plot with custom colors
DimPlot(data_obj, reduction = "umap.unintegrated") +
    scale_color_manual(values = cluster_colors_m) +
    theme_minimal() +
    ggtitle("UMAP")
```
